detail.longDescription: I had a lawn mowing business for a summer growing up. My customers consisted mainly of my parents' friends and maybe a neighbor or two who felt charitable enough to let me defile their lawn. When someone needed their lawn cut, they typically told my parents, who told me, which I then wrote in a notebook that lived in the corner of my room.
